title: 内存碎片率 mem_fragmentation_ratio
expected_output:
内存碎片率 mem_fragmentation_ratio = used_memory_rss / used_memory
  健康: used_memory=100MB rss=110MB ratio=1.10
  碎片严重(>1.5): used_memory=100MB rss=200MB ratio=2.00
  小于1(换出swap): used_memory=200MB rss=100MB ratio=0.50
  ratio>1.5 -> 碎片多, 可启用 activedefrag 或重启; ratio<1 -> 内存被 OS 换页, 性能骤降
code:
def frag_ratio(used_memory, rss):
    return rss / used_memory

print("内存碎片率 mem_fragmentation_ratio = used_memory_rss / used_memory")
cases = [("健康", 100, 110), ("碎片严重(>1.5)", 100, 200), ("小于1(换出swap)", 200, 100)]
for name, u, r in cases:
    print(f"  {name}: used_memory={u}MB rss={r}MB ratio={frag_ratio(u, r):.2f}")
print("  ratio>1.5 -> 碎片多, 可启用 activedefrag 或重启; ratio<1 -> 内存被 OS 换页, 性能骤降")
